requirements.requirement: Result and diagnostic admission precedes payload copying
requirements.details: Borrowed output measurement, checked UTF-8 bytes/nodes/depth/entry metrics, exact live temporary overlap, cancellation between render chunks, and allocator observations distinguishing evaluated inputs, output buffers, sorting slots, and diagnostic fields.

requirements.requirement: Default catalogue, CLI metadata, examples, documentation and conformance
requirements.details: Sixteen string statements bring the fixed catalogue to 41 slots; metadata, registration overrides, snapshot boundaries, completion, reference block and example 30 remain executable.

generated_discovery.note: Discovery verifies expanded configuration; no generated campaign score is claimed.

validation_scope: Full GNU/musl debug/release suites: 1,585 passing tests each; strict Clippy on both targets, formatting, and coverage/mutation helper checks. Fourteen focused mutations run against an isolated source snapshot with library/CLI unit, strings and allocation tests.
review_notes: Initial test fixtures used unsupported DSL escapes for CR/tab/regex backslashes. Fixtures were corrected and CR/tab/NUL behavior moved to explicit host inputs; grammar behavior was not expanded.

The expanded fixed catalogue caused 13 admitted statement-table copies to cross an older 8 KiB diagnostic-allocation observation threshold. The fixture paths were lengthened and the threshold raised to 16 KiB so the complete cycle detail remains above the threshold while admitted table copies remain below it. Rejection still requires zero detail allocations and success exactly one.

Formatting measures maps with unsorted borrowed display to avoid sorting allocation before admission, then renders sorted keys after admission. A dedicated allocator probe detects reversing this order.

Case preflight sums scalar mapping UTF-8 lengths; the sole context-sensitive default lowercase exception is Greek sigma, whose alternatives have equal UTF-8 width. Rendering uses the standard whole-string lowercase implementation and contextual examples verify the metrics.

Regex metadata and output values use existing argument/result/diagnostic admission. Regex compiler/cache scratch has separate documented fixed limits, and only regex operations join Log and host callbacks on the bounded async worker path.
All signatures and runnable example text were checked against CLI help/reference before full validation. No production limits were raised to accommodate the larger catalogue.

preliminary_allocation_observation.finding: Existing import-cycle allocation oracle counted 13 enlarged statement tables at its old threshold. The fixture repair described above passed focused and full validation.

dependency.name: regex
dependency.purpose: Bounded Unicode regex search and captures; locked transitive packages are recorded by Cargo.lock.

limits: This is the documented sixteen-signature string catalogue, not complete Robot Framework String API compatibility.
Scalar indexes are not grapheme-cluster indexes. Case/whitespace tables follow the Rust toolchain; regex Unicode tables follow the locked crate. No normalization or locale tailoring is performed.

Regex search accounting is deterministic suffix-byte admission, not a wall-clock or CPU instruction bound. A single compile/search cannot be preempted; async worker cancellation retains the existing ownership/draining contract.
Formatting supplies explicit Array/Map values and readable Botwork display. It does not evaluate code, perform JSON serialization, or implement arbitrary format specifiers.
No Windows/macOS validation, new coverage percentage, complete generated mutation score, or release-level performance claim is made by this evidence.

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, tempfile, os
root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="strings-",dir=root/"target"))
print(f"validation record: {out / 'summary.json'}",flush=True)
inputs=[p for d in ('src','tests','examples') for p in (root/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
inputs += sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md')) + [root/'README.md']
inputs += [root/p for p in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo/mutants.toml','scripts/coverage.py')]
record={'complete':False,'started':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs},'checks':[]}
focused=['--test','setup_failure','--test','suite_fixtures','--test','documentation','--test','examples','--test','conformance']
commands=[('gnu-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked']),('gnu-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release']),('musl-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('musl-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('clippy-gnu',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('clippy-musl',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('format',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check']),('coverage-helper',['python3','tests/coverage_tools.py']),('mutation-helper',['python3','tests/mutation_tools.py'])]

try:
 for label,command in commands:
  print('running '+label,flush=True)
  log=out/(label+'.log')
  with log.open('w') as stream:
   result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1200,env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2'))
  content=log.read_text()
  rows=re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',content)
  check={'label':label,'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'tests':dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored'),[sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)]))}
  record['checks'].append(check)
  (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(check),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print(content[-12000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 record['complete']=True
finally:
 record['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
